Stay safe

1. See the room first
Visit in person before you pay anything.

2. Never pay a reservation fee to someone you haven’t met
That includes GCash and bank transfers.

3. ECStay never asks for payment
You pay the Keeper directly, after you’ve seen the room. If someone asks you to pay ECStay, it isn’t us.
